texts.description: An advanced, locally-hosted AI system using the latest YOLO models for real-time box counting, size classification, and dimension estimation. Optimized for warehouses and logistics centers: detects, counts, and categorizes boxes on conveyors or shelves with high accuracy, integrating seamlessly with your inventory systems.
